semanticMeaning: Explicit runtime illumination/visibility condition for Veilwild that supports search readability without making camouflage either arbitrary darkness or trivial exposure.
representationCarrier: Godot 4.7.1 scene resource plus machine-readable JSON contract
revisionArtifactIdentity: lighting_rig.tscn sha256:0b558d1c760a6cfd176dd0c2c2879c0512da362de78da0fd889f86c7ad557210; exact A11 commit published separately

unitsCoordinateConventions.worldUnits: Godot 3D units treated as meters for fixture only; real environment owner must confirm
unitsCoordinateConventions.energyUnits: Godot renderer-relative light_energy / ambient_light_energy; not photometric lux claims

preconditions: A04 visual grammar must either accept or replace fixture-default aesthetic parameters before product standing relies on them.
A05 real environment geometry/concealment contexts and A10 material response must be replayed under this rig or an accepted revision.
A12 camouflage shader must remain state/environment-responsive under the lighting condition; lighting must not compensate by hiding or spotlighting the creature.
A17 must ensure an explicit WorldEnvironment/DirectionalLight3D reach runtime; editor preview sun/sky is inadmissible.
Any Camera3D Environment override must be declared because it can supersede WorldEnvironment semantics.
A20/F21 evaluates shadow/GI/render cost on the integrated exact condition; fixture cost is not transportable.
consumerVisibleFailureModes: runtime scene has no explicit light/environment despite editor appearing lit
camera Environment override changes exposure/ambient semantics
deep shadow crush makes search arbitrary or inaccessible
excess ambient/key energy trivializes silhouette and camouflage
shadow split/fade/pancake behavior produces popping, acne or unstable concealment cues
real environment/material/camouflage integration invalidates fixture tuning
lighting settings cause material frame-time or pacing cost on exact integrated condition
validationOracle: On the exact integrated scene/build/camera/render condition, explicit authored lighting is present and mechanically stable; real environment/material/camouflage remains readable enough to preserve declared cues without collapsing concealment. Human detectability/usefulness/fairness remain UNKNOWN until real participant evidence.
